title: Show recognized text in archive entry selectors
changes: Show a bounded recognized-text preview alongside entry IDs in all four text browsers while retaining their original selector values.
Represent unknown glyphs explicitly, separate command runs with spaces and retain numeric-only labels when no glyph is recognized or the profile is not European.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-text-labels-synthetic-xdsx_e9s passed label, fallback, truncation and existing text-control tests in Linux Chrome.
Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-text-labels-local-bogtcyng checked all four selectors and a narrow viewport without changing embedded data.
Docker unit rom-data-viewer-text-labels-docker-eacja4wc matched Python output for synthetic input; the ignored text page was published with hash guards.
limitations: Labels use only the visually matched European glyph subset and do not execute commands or infer names for unrelated IDs. Target was unavailable, so Docker used a synthetic dataset; Windows remains unverified.
